recommendation.reason: With the best comparable score now 70.9% (paper, 2026-11-09), recommend needs both Real and Solid to be strong.
risks: New benchmark with low attention and no independent leaderboard

release.quote: Game code, task definitions, rendering assets, and evaluation runners are included in this repository.

redistribution_questions: What license applies to the GTAVBench task data and Hugging Face dataset?
Does the inherited MIT license cover only native-city game code?
Can GTA V-derived screenshots and task definitions be redistributed?
What does publicReleaseAuthorization 'not verified' mean for character assets?
rights.quote: Asset-specific licenses and provenance remain in [licenses/](licenses/) and alongside the assets; the inherited game code retains its [MIT license](native-city/LICENSE).

tasks.quote: The [Hugging Face dataset](https://huggingface.co/datasets/OpenMOSS-Team/GTAVBench) contains all 150 test tasks as Parquet, with seven fields: `id`, `category`, `instruction`, `initial_observation`, `environment_type`, `movement`, and `play_url`.

verifier.full_credit: Engine state determines task outcomes; shooting tasks use point-in-polygon gold checks.

network_or_api: model provider API configured via baseURL/model/api/effort
exceptions: Image-based shooting generation requires an imported annotated image pool; sniping is evaluation-only.
runtime.quote: Requirements: **Linux, Node.js 22.18+, Python 3, FFmpeg with `libx264`, and Chromium's Linux dependencies**. Automated GPU evaluation also needs a working graphics driver.

readiness.next_action: Clone ljbro/GTAGym and start the local server on port 4200.
